notes.title: Demo - Steam Next Fest
notes.notes: [p]Welcome back, Survivors![/p][p][/p][p]Today, we have some exciting news about [i]Undead Awakens[/i] and the future of the project![/p][p][/p][p][b]Demo Now Available![/b][/p][p][/p][p]The first playable demo version of [i]Undead Awakens[/i] is now live on Steam – exclusively as part of the Steam Game Preview! Unlike originally planned, this demo already supports multiplayer for up to 4 players and local splitscreen. This is your chance to experience the vision of [i]Undead Awakens[/i] up close and be part of the development from the start![/p][p]Please note: This is an early version, and it may still contain bugs and will likely undergo significant changes throughout development.[/p][p][b]What to expect in the demo:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Transit Mode:[/b] (Currently farm map with station)[/p][/*][*][p]9 Weapons[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mystery Case[/b] – Get random weapons[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mystery Attachment Case[/b] – Random attachments for your weapons[/p][/*][*][p]1 Playable Character[/p][/*][*][p]2 Turrets: Minigun & MK10 Grenade Turret[/p][/*][*][p][b]Air Support:[/b] A-10 Airstrike & AH-64 Helicopter Support[/p][/*][*][p][b]Perks:[/b] Bulletproof, Adrenaline, Painkiller[/p][/*][*][p][b]DLSS 4 & FSR 3.1 Support[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Future:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The demo offers the first opportunity to collect direct feedback from the community. This way, [i]Undead Awakens[/i] can become a true community-driven project even before the Early Access release and stay true to its vision. Much is likely to change before Early Access, so expect the game to evolve significantly. The demo will remain available and will be regularly updated with hotfixes and gameplay updates, ensuring everyone stays up-to-date and that feedback is continuously integrated.[/p][p]For selected testers, there will be regular playtests after the Steam Game Preview to focus on specific aspects of the game. More information on this will follow soon.[/p][p][b]Community Feedback:[/b][/p][p]Community feedback remains a central aspect of [i]Undead Awakens[/i]. On our Discord server, you can report bugs, share ideas, and discuss the game. Feel free to stop by and share your thoughts![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/g4t88QHa7h"]https://discord.gg/g4t88QHa7h[/url][/p]

notes.title: First Open Development Test and the current state
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome to Undead Awakens[/b]

In this short post, I want to give you some insights into the current state of Undead Awakens, the team, the main goals of the project, and the upcoming first playtest.

[b]Project Overview[/b]

Undead Awakens is an ambitious project currently being developed by a single person using Unreal Engine 5. My goal is to create a unique yet classic round-based zombie survival experience while involving the community early in the development process.

Currently, Undead Awakens is slightly over halfway through development. The core mechanics are already implemented, but they still require adjustments and fine-tuning. Right now, the focus is on completing the single-player mode and the local co-op mode. A multiplayer co-op mode will also be available in the future.

[b]First Open Development Test[/b]

I am excited to announce that the first open development test will begin soon! This test will include the single-player mode as well as a local splitscreen mode for up to four players. Stay tuned for more detailed information about this soon!

[b]Join the Community[/b]

I invite all of you to be part of this exciting first step. Your feedback is incredibly valuable, and together we can make Undead Awakens an outstanding gaming experience! In this spirit, I am happy to share the link to our new Discord channel. This gives you a unique opportunity to engage with the development of Undead Awakens by sharing ideas, reporting bugs, and participating in constructive discussions:

https://discord.gg/g4t88QHa7h

[b]
Stay Updated[/b]

Make sure to stay tuned so you don't miss anything, and get ready to experience the first test yourself soon!

Thank you for your support,

The Undead Awakens Team
